Full bouquet including stems entirely in frame, portrait 2:3. Centered with generous negative space. Seamless warm milk ivory background #F5F1E8, soft natural side daylight from upper left, subtle grounding shadow, true flower textures, naturally imperfect stems, restrained realistic colors. Same coherent studio session across the collection. No hands, no vase, no paper wrapping, no props, no lettering, no logos, no watermark.
